reviews.title: Solid processor at a solid price
reviews.comment: I used this CPU to build a starter gaming computer. It does a great job. It has built-in video, but if you're a serious gamer, you'll probably want to add a dedicated graphics card.
reviews.author: umbighouse

reviews.title: Great choice for low cost PC Gaming..... but it's faster than we thought it would be!
reviews.comment: I have a customer who needed a new PC for his son to play video games. He was on a budget so we decided to go with this i5-7400. Well it turned out to be a good choice and with the Sapphire Pulse GPU (graphics card) his son is getting 76 FPS with Shadow of the Tomb Raider. He's happy!!
reviews.author: TECHNolli

reviews.title: Intel n00b, so far impressed.
reviews.comment: First Intel CPU I've used in one of my self-built machines. So far this thing has been a beast and has handled all the things being thrown at it, still need to try GalCiv 3 on it in a larger galaxy which would bring my prior machine not only to it's knees but to the desktop too. I almost wish I had a 2k monitor to push it a bit harder.

reviews.title: Not as Described "3.5GHZ" Not Base
reviews.comment: I placed an order for product "BX80677I57400 " which is advertised as a 3.5GHZ processor. I returned the original received as it was marked as a 3.0GHZ. The replacement was also a 3.0GHZ. The item is incorrectly labeled as a 3.5GHZ when it is in fact a 3.0 with turbo. This is not as advertised and for those placing orders you will want to check into this to be sure you want this product before placing the order. 99% of processors on the market are posted as base clock speeds and it is a bit shady this would be listed at the turbo speed. This has caused a lot of frustration as I have now had to return two products and will not get the refund until the 2nd is received delaying my PC from being completed. This information is important for those building specific types of PCs and really should be noted in the products description.
reviews.author: Veebear
